versions.label: Version and module availability
command: import sys,json,importlib.metadata as m; out={'python':sys.version.split()[0]}; out.update({k:m.version(k) for k in sys.argv[1:]}); print(json.dumps(out));

steps.label: Execute exact native checks on the variant
Exact declared positive file and independent negative control
command:
import yara
from pathlib import Path
assert yara.__version__ == '4.5.4', yara.__version__
assert Path('greeting.txt').read_bytes() == b'Hello, World!\n'
assert Path('negative.txt').read_bytes() == b'Hello, Moon!\n'
rules = yara.compile(filepath='hello.yara')
positive = [match.rule for match in rules.match(filepath='greeting.txt')]
negative = [match.rule for match in rules.match(filepath='negative.txt')]
assert positive == ['CorpusGreeting'], positive
assert negative == [], negative
print('greeting.txt: CorpusGreeting')
print('negative.txt: no match')
